rows.en: A development experiment for New Baronium.

Mm…

Red Baron's super alloy Baronium, which can withstand 100,000 degrees of heat, is certainly superb…

However…

my research revealed a weakness: it is very vulnerable when an intense Heat Ray is combined with Dissolving Fluid!

So I carried out experiments to make Baronium even stronger.
Make Baronium even stronger…?
I wondered if we could make a super alloy that could also resist Heat Rays and Dissolving Fluid.

But… a furnace that can process Baronium isn't something you find just anywhere…

…!?

Don't tell me? Doctor!?

That's right…

I carried out the Baronium strengthening experiments at a TDF research facility.
As a member of the TDF science group.
Red Baron is one of the guardian gods of us humans, after all… The TDF gave me a very warm welcome.
But what are you going to do with strengthened Baronium?
The Seven Secrets of Red Baron!
Seven secrets?

First, the Baron Missile launch ports and the eyes!

From the moment a missile is launched, it takes 0.7 seconds for the port to close…

If an enemy hits it during that window, it's the same as a direct hit on the powder magazine!

So… we'll install a shutter-type opening mechanism to eliminate that gap!!

The eyes will be replaced with super-reinforced glass that can withstand heat of over 200,000 degrees.
And the other 5 secrets?
Those are… doubling the power of the Electrigger and the Baron Punch!
Doubling…?
On top of that, we'll add a new weapon, the Drill Arrow! And then equip it with Rockets for use in space.
For use in space?
Mm… And finally, so it can fly freely through space, we'll make it able to equip Space Wings.
Whoa, that's so cool…
I see… Now I understand why the plan was carried out in top secret.
And above all, the big thing is that this super alloy Baronium can now be mass-produced.
Mass-produced?
The TDF is already preparing to develop super weapons and fighters that use this super alloy.
This should be a great step forward for all of us humans…
These seven secrets have been recorded on this film.
Thank you very much. I'll take responsibility for keeping it safe.
Boss, inside the wristwatch?
Daisaku!
Yes…?
Keep this wristwatch on you at all times!
What!? The wristwatch with the film in it? Something this important… me?
It has a time lock, so it won't open until a set time comes!
Y-yes, sir…
Daisaku, don't take it off even when you get in the bath, okay?
Oh, that's right… That watch isn't waterproof, so be careful.
Boo hoo hoo…
Hee hee… Daisaku, that's a big role, isn't it?
Ha ha ha…
And so… mass production of the super alloy Baronium was in place. With new protection in hand, the steel giant will surely become a shield for the peace of Earth…
And the giant Electronic Brain, Brain, begins calculating its next terrifying strategy. When will the robot war be settled? Today, too, the giants of justice fight on!
Defeat all Trojan Horses!
Defeat all Trojan Horses within 1 turn!
Help Kenichiro Kurenai and defeat all Trojan Horses and Gigants!
Ken Kurenai is defeated
Ken Kurenai is defeated, or all Trojan Horses are not destroyed within 1 turn
Ken Kurenai is defeated, or the Hiryu piloted by Kenichiro Kurenai is destroyed
<c3>Tsuyoshi Kaijo</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Daita Oiwa</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Kenji Asuka</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Hideki Go</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
Then let us hear this strategy…

Sir!

We will raid EAGLE's Scientific Weapons Laboratory, obtain their analysis data on the Gorenger Suits, and strike at their weak points!
Mm…

Nuoooooh!!

Put it into action at once! Defeat Gorenger without fail!
Fire the Navaron Cannon at EAGLE's Scientific Weapons Laboratory!!
Sir!
Listen up! Everyone, hear me out!
The kaiju is here right now!
2 kilometers ahead of it is the No. 1 Nuclear Power Plant.
If that gets hit, Tokyo's power supply will stop completely and there'll be total chaos! We have to take that kaiju down no matter what. Got it!
Kiiih! Kiiiih!
(My attacks… My attacks aren't working!?)
Ultraman…
I can't believe it!? The invincible Ultraman, beaten…

Large amounts of radiation have been detected around where the kaiju appeared.

The kaiju probably breathes a radioactive ray!
A radioactive ray?
I see… That's why it attacked the nuclear power plant! It loves uranium!

Mm… That may be so!

Minami, the kaiju will probably attack the No. 1 Nuclear Power Plant again. Keep a close watch!
At the same time that MAT withdrew, Gorenger too had been defeated by General Magman's mobile fortress Navaron and the formidable Diamond Mask, and was forced to retreat.
EAGLE's Scientific Weapons Laboratory had been attacked by Navaron, and the analysis data on the "Gorenger Suits" stolen!
The Gorenger Suits were no use.

Now that the data has been stolen… we can never wear them again.

Right now, I'm having the "New Gorenger Suits" made as quickly as possible under Dr. Kuroda's direction. Stand by for a while.

Yes… If it's Dr. Kuroda, who just joined the TDF science group, then I can rest easy.

Peggy! The Gorenger Storm is no use now! I'm counting on you for the "New Ball"…
OK!

The Black Cross Army has strengthened its forces too. We can't afford to be careless!

Hm? Where's Ki?
Ah… well… um… He's being careless, all right.
What?
Ah… Achoo!!
Oh? Mr. Oiwa, do you have a cold? Are you all right?

U08700/U08703: 1ターン音着に read as 1ターン以内に; 思朽 as 全滅.
U08702/U08703: 灼区 read as 紅健 (from the parallel row U08704).
U08711/U08712: narration-kind row continues the Fuhrer's line.
U08715-U08718: Kato's briefing split over narration-kind rows; translated as his speech.
U08724: 放射能光線 rendered "radioactive ray".
U08735: Akira's pun on うかうか (Edogawa's "can't be careless"): rendered "He's being careless, all right." Ki = Daita Oiwa (Kirenger).
